requirements.text: Write a Python module dupes.py providing duplicate_groups(files).
Files with exactly equal contents are duplicates; return one group (sorted list of all paths) per content shared by two or more paths.
Contents that belong to only one path produce no group; if there are no duplicates return [].
Order the groups by their first path (each group is the sorted list of its paths).

validations.evidence: R2: duplicate_groups returned [['a', 'b'], ['c']]
Contents belonging to only one path produce no group: The >= 1 condition emits singleton groups for unique files.
